## Overview

Experiment thay 3 thứ trên ad listing page của Việc Làm Tốt: **(1)** cách modal FOMO Banner được kích hoạt (từ tap section CTA → scroll-triggered), **(2)** wording trong drawer (warm-intro variant giới thiệu concept "hồ sơ hoàn thiện → nhận thêm lời mời"), **(3)** visibility của FOMO Banner Section trong feed. Mục tiêu: nâng completion rate của matching flow từ 4% → 10%+ bằng cách kiểm tra hypothesis là banner blindness (visibility issue) chứ không phải value-prop issue.

Toàn bộ **interactions bên trong drawer (chọn mức lương, submit)** inherit từ production hiện tại — spec này chỉ mô tả delta.

---

## Display Condition

Modal warm-intro (Data + Consent variant) hiển thị khi **tất cả** điều kiện sau được thỏa:

```
1. User đang ở experiment CT-BUYER.fomo_banner_scroll_triggered variant treatment_b HOẶC treatment_c
2. User CHƯA complete banner flow ở session trước (persistent flag)
3. User CHƯA dismiss / open modal ở session hiện tại
4. User thuộc Group 1 eligibility:
   - Not logged in, OR
   - Logged in nhưng thiếu ≥ 1 trong 3 matching fields (job type, location, salary), OR
   - Logged in nhưng chưa có phone number
5. User đã kéo qua Nth job ad card (N=5 default, config DB, no redeploy)
   → chỉ ad cards mới count; skip promoted slots, section headers, non-ad elements
   → trigger ngay khi card thứ N fully enters viewport (không phải khi rời viewport)

SHOW example:
  User treatment_b, not logged in, filter "Bán hàng" ở "TP HCM", scroll qua ad card #5
  → drawer trượt lên từ dưới (Non-login variant, có Lock icon)

HIDE example:
  User treatment_b, logged in + đủ 3 field + consented=true → NEVER trigger, section cũng không render

Điều kiện bổ sung:
  - Trigger fire tối đa 1 lần / session / user
  - Nếu user close X hoặc tap outside → không re-open trong session, feed tiếp tục bình thường
  - Nếu user leave page trước khi complete và quay lại → scroll counter reset, có thể re-fire
```

**Modal warm-intro (Consent-Only variant)** hiển thị cho Group 2 (logged-in + đủ 3 field + consented=false). Chi tiết copy/anatomy: **checkpoint #1 Non-blocking**.

**Modal control (existing production)** hiển thị cho variant A khi user tap section CTA — unchanged, dev đã có spec cũ.

## Display Position

| Platform | Vị trí trong trang / screen |
|----------|-----------------------------|
| App (iOS + Android) | Bottom-sheet drawer — trượt lên từ cạnh dưới, chiếm toàn width, height = wrap-content, background feed dim overlay (`background-overlay #22222280`) |
| Desktop | Modal center — floating card 400px wide (approx từ screenshot), background page dim overlay |

**Section (FOMO Banner Section) trong feed:**

| Variant | Section rendered? | Ghi chú |
|---|---|---|
| `control` | ✅ Visible | Existing behavior, tap section CTA để mở existing modal |
| `treatment_b` | ❌ Hidden | Section KHÔNG render — modal chỉ trigger qua scroll |
| `treatment_c` | ✅ Visible | Section render như control; modal trigger qua BOTH tap CTA + scroll |

---

## Interaction Rules

| Trigger | Hành vi |
|---------|---------|
| Scroll past Nth ad card (treatment_b, treatment_c, eligible user) | Drawer slide-up từ dưới (App) / modal appear center (Desktop). Fire `job_fomo_banner_modal_impression` với `trigger_source: scroll_trigger` |
| Tap section CTA (control + treatment_c) | Same drawer/modal open. Fire `job_fomo_banner_modal_impression` với `trigger_source: section_cta` |
| Tap X trên drawer header | Dismiss. Modal close, KHÔNG re-open trong session. `treatment_b`: không inject section vào feed. `treatment_c`: section vẫn giữ. |
| Tap outside drawer (overlay) | Same as tap X — dismiss with no re-open |
| Tap 1 trong 4 salary chip | Follow production drawer behavior (unchanged) |
| Tap CTA "Hoàn tất để nhận lời mời" (Login) / "Hoàn tất và tạo hồ sơ" (Non-login) | Follow production behavior — submit salary + trigger matching flow. Fire `job_fomo_banner_modal_salary_submit` |
| Complete flow | Fire `job_fomo_banner_complete`. Persist flag: user hoàn thành → không trigger session sau |
| Navigate away + return (chưa complete) | Scroll counter reset. Có thể fire lại sau N cards. |
| Treatment_c: đã open modal 1 lần qua section CTA | Scroll trigger KHÔNG re-open trong session |

---

## Common Rules

Shared rules áp dụng cho tất cả screens trong flow.

```yaml
common-rules:
  variant-behavior:
    control:
      section-visible: true
      scroll-trigger: false
      modal-variant: existing-production   # unchanged, dev đã có spec cũ
    treatment_b:
      section-visible: false
      scroll-trigger: true
      modal-variant: warm-intro
    treatment_c:
      section-visible: true
      scroll-trigger: true
      modal-variant: warm-intro
      trigger-both-sources: true            # tap CTA + scroll đều mở modal (once-per-session)

  scroll-trigger-logic:
    default-N: 5
    N-source: database-config
    N-hot-reload: true                       # QA verify: đổi N không cần redeploy
    counter-eligibility: "job ad card fully enters viewport"
    counter-exclusions: [promoted-slot, section-header, non-ad-element]
    counter-reset-on-navigate: true          # rời page + quay lại → count lại
    max-fires-per-session: 1

  modal-variant-selection:
    group-1:
      rule: "not-logged-in OR (logged-in AND missing ≥1 of [job-type, location, salary]) OR (logged-in AND no-phone)"
      modal: warm-intro-data-consent
    group-2:
      rule: "logged-in AND all-3-fields-saved AND consented_to_matching = false"
      modal: warm-intro-consent-only         # checkpoint #1 Non-blocking
    excluded:
      rule: "logged-in AND all-3-fields-saved AND consented_to_matching = true"
      modal: none                             # SectionJobMatching render bình thường, no popup

  eligibility-exclusion:
    - "user completed banner flow in prior session → excluded permanently — SectionJobMatching hiển thị bình thường, no section, no popup"
    - "user dismissed modal in current session → không re-fire same session"

  count-display:
    "17 Lời Mời":
      source: backend real invitation count
      format: "render as-returned, no truncation, no format cap"   # user confirmed
      pluralization: "Vietnamese không có singular/plural — dùng 'Lời Mời' cho mọi số"

  ecs-events:
    impression:
      name: job_fomo_banner_modal_impression
      fields: [ab_variant, trigger_source]
    salary-submit:
      name: job_fomo_banner_modal_salary_submit
      fields: [ab_variant, trigger_source]
    complete:
      name: job_fomo_banner_complete
      fields: [ab_variant, trigger_source]
    dimension-enums:
      ab_variant: [control, treatment_b, treatment_c]
      trigger_source: [section_cta, scroll_trigger]
    publish-status: "draft in ECS — publish before release"

  loading-pattern: reuse production
  error-pattern: reuse production
  empty-state: N/A                            # only eligible users trigger, count guaranteed ≥ 1
```

## Screen 1 — Ad Listing (App + Desktop): Scroll-Trigger + Section Visibility

```yaml
mode: partial
screen: ad-listing-feed
insert-after: filter-bar

screen-context:
  existing-order:
    - page-root                    # existing column · gap: spacing-0
      - top-navigation             # existing — do not modify
      - filter-bar                 # existing — do not modify
      - ★ fomo-banner-section      # ← EXISTING node — visibility toggled per variant
      - ad-listing-feed            # existing — modal overlay lives ABOVE this on trigger
      - bottom-navigation          # existing (App only)

# Spacing note:
#   fomo-banner-section giữ nguyên vị trí cũ trong feed.
#   Delta: visibility rule mới (per variant) + scroll-trigger listener trên container ad-listing-feed.
#   Modal open không thay đổi DOM order — nó là overlay layer (position: fixed / absolute).

id: fomo-banner-section
type: existing                     # KHÔNG spec lại anatomy — production đã có
visible-if: $ref common-rules.variant-behavior.[variant].section-visible

  # LOGIC ONLY — anatomy unchanged from production
  # control        → visible (as-is)
  # treatment_b    → hidden (do not render, do not reserve space)
  # treatment_c    → visible (as-is, same as control)

id: scroll-trigger-listener
type: behavior                     # non-visual — script layer
visible-if: $ref common-rules.variant-behavior.[variant].scroll-trigger
props:
  count-target: $ref common-rules.scroll-trigger-logic.default-N
  count-source: $ref common-rules.scroll-trigger-logic.N-source
  count-eligibility: $ref common-rules.scroll-trigger-logic.counter-eligibility
  count-exclusions: $ref common-rules.scroll-trigger-logic.counter-exclusions
  on-trigger: "open warm-intro drawer (variant per group)"
  session-guard: $ref common-rules.scroll-trigger-logic.max-fires-per-session
```

**Ad listing card layout (unchanged):** dev reference existing `SectionJobMatching` component + ad card layout in production codebase. Spec này không re-declare card anatomy.

## Screen 2 — Warm-Intro Drawer: Data + Consent (Login variant, Group 1 b/c)

```yaml
mode: partial
screen: warm-intro-drawer-login
insert-after: none
replaces: existing-fomo-modal      # for treatment_b + treatment_c only

# Frame reference: Figma node 16531:16875 (Version B Drawer/ Login)
# Anatomy source: Figma screenshot + get_variable_defs (get_design_context blocked by permission).
#                 Internal salary picker + CTA interactions inherit from production.
# Delta from production: title copy, user row copy, instruction copy.
```

```yaml
id: warm-intro-drawer-data-consent
type: column
size: adaptive                     # App: full-width bottom-sheet · Desktop: 400px centered modal
background: Background/Light/background-primary (#ffffff)
radius: radius-modal (20px)         # top-only for App bottom-sheet; all-corners for Desktop
padding: { y: spacing-20, x: spacing-16 }
gap: spacing-16

children:
  - id: drawer-header
    type: row
    justify: flex-start
    align: center
    children:
      - component: Icon Button
        variant: ghost
        props: { icon: Close-outline, on-tap: "dismiss drawer" }
        tokens: { icon: Icon/icon-primary (#222222) }
        width: 32
        height: 32

  - id: title
    type: text
    content: "17 Công ty **Bán Hàng** ở **TP Hồ Chí Minh** đang gửi lời mời ứng tuyển tới các ứng viên đủ hồ sơ"
    typography: header-page          # 20px / 600 / 28px — from get_variable_defs Header/Page
    tokens: { text: Text/text-primary (#222222) }
    content-rule: |
      - "17" = real invitation count ($ref common-rules.count-display)
      - "Bán Hàng" = user's job type filter, rendered bold
      - "TP Hồ Chí Minh" = user's location filter, rendered bold
      - bold segments use inline emphasis inside body text (not separate label component)
    text-align: center

  - id: invitation-preview
    type: stack                      # 3 chat cards fanned/tilted behind each other
    content-rule: |
      - Illustrative — hard-coded UI example, not real user invitations
      - Anatomy: 3 card layers with slight rotation/offset creating "peek" stack
      - Each card = chat bubble with sender avatar, company name, verified badge, timestamp, message body
      - Dev reference: existing production drawer illustration (unchanged from prod)
    checkpoint:
      question: "Illustration là static asset (export PNG/SVG) hay React component render 3 stacked cards?"
      owner: dev
      blocking: false

  - id: user-row
    type: row
    gap: spacing-12
    align: center
    padding: { y: spacing-12, x: spacing-16 }
    background: Background/Light/background-primary (#ffffff)
    border: Border/border-thin (#e8e8e8)
    radius: radius-card-small (8px)
    children:
      - id: avatar
        type: image
        src: "[user-profile-avatar]"
        width: 40
        height: 40
        border-radius: radius-pill (999)
        content-rule: fallback to placeholder icon if no photo

      - id: user-text
        type: column
        gap: spacing-2
        children:
          - type: text
            content: "Hồ sơ hoàn thiện 65%"
            typography: body-caption   # 12px / 400 / 18px
            tokens: { text: Text/text-secondary (#595959) }
            content-rule: "65% = real profile completion % from backend"

          - type: text
            content: "Cập nhật ngay để nhận **17 Lời Mời** ứng tuyển này!"
            typography: label-page      # 16px / 700 / 24px
            tokens: { text: Text/text-primary (#222222) }
            content-rule: |
              - Copy sau unify (Q1 interview) — same wording cho cả App và Desktop
              - Trước audit: App drawer (frame 16531:16875) có copy khác "Có 17 Lời Mời đang chờ Nguyễn Phương Anh"
              - Designer confirm: dùng copy Desktop cho cả 2 platform (source: Q1 interview)
              - "17 Lời Mời" segment: color text-info (#306BD9 for JOB) + weight 700
              - $ref common-rules.count-display cho pluralization + max-content
            checkpoint:
              question: "App drawer Figma frame 16531:16875 đã sync về copy này chưa? Nếu chưa, designer cần update trước handoff."
              owner: design
              blocking: false

  - id: instruction-text
    type: text
    content: "Cập nhật mức lương mong muốn vào hồ sơ để nhận các lời mời"
    typography: body-section         # 14px / 400 / 20px
    tokens: { text: Text/text-primary (#222222) }
    text-align: center
    content-rule: "Copy unified — same App + Desktop (Q1 confirmed)"

  - id: salary-picker
    type: grid
    columns: 2
    gap: spacing-8
    children:
      - component: Chip
        variant: filter
        state: default
        props: { label: "6-9 triệu", value: "6-9" }
        tokens:
          bg: Background/Light/background-primary (#ffffff)
          border: Border/border-regular (#dddddd)
          text: Text/text-primary (#222222)
        width: fill
        height: 40
      - component: Chip
        variant: filter
        state: default
        props: { label: "10-15 triệu", value: "10-15" }
        tokens:
          bg: Background/Light/background-primary (#ffffff)
          border: Border/border-regular (#dddddd)
          text: Text/text-primary (#222222)
        width: fill
        height: 40
      - component: Chip
        variant: filter
        state: default
        props: { label: "16-20 triệu", value: "16-20" }
        tokens:
          bg: Background/Light/background-primary (#ffffff)
          border: Border/border-regular (#dddddd)
          text: Text/text-primary (#222222)
        width: fill
        height: 40
      - component: Chip
        variant: filter
        state: default
        props: { label: "Trên 20 triệu", value: "20+" }
        tokens:
          bg: Background/Light/background-primary (#ffffff)
          border: Border/border-regular (#dddddd)
          text: Text/text-primary (#222222)
        width: fill
        height: 40

  - component: Button
    variant: primary
    size: L - 40px
    state: disabled                  # disabled until user picks 1 salary chip (production behavior)
    props:
      label: "Hoàn tất để nhận lời mời"
      width: full
      on-tap: "$ref common-rules.ecs-events.salary-submit + production submit handler"
    # figma: Size=L-40px, Type=🥇Primary, State=Disabled (initial), isPill=No
    tokens:
      bg: Button/Solid/button-disabled (#c0c0c0)
      text: Text/text-blank (#ffffff)
    width: fill
    height: 40
```

## Accessibility

| Requirement | Details |
|-------------|---------|
| Focus order | Close X → Title (skip decorative) → User row / Lock block → Instruction text → Salary Chip 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → CTA |
| ARIA labels | Close X: `aria-label="Đóng"`. Salary chips: use native `<button>` role. CTA: text content is label. Lock icon: `aria-hidden="true"` (decorative). |
| Touch targets | Minimum 44×44pt — Chip height 40px cần verify tap target. Icon Button 32px cần verify padding hit-area ≥ 44px. |
| Colour contrast | text-info (#306BD9) trên background-primary (#ffffff) = 4.98:1 (AA large text). Verify tất cả text tokens đạt AA 4.5:1 body / 3:1 large. |
| Screen reader announcement | Drawer open → announce "Hộp thoại: 17 Công ty [X] ở [Y] đang gửi lời mời...". Focus trap trong drawer khi open. |
| Keyboard (Desktop) | Esc key → dismiss (same as X). Tab traverses focus order above. Enter on chip → select. Enter on CTA → submit. |

## Known DS Gotchas (JOB-specific)

- [ ] **JOB button-primary = #306BD9** (NOT #FA6819 which is PTY, NOT #FFD400 which is GDS/VEH)
- [ ] **JOB text-brand = #306BD9** (NOT #CC8F00 which is GDS)
- [ ] **JOB icon-brand = #306BD9** (NOT #FFBA00 which is GDS/VEH)
- [ ] **JOB text-on-background = #FFFFFF** (white on brand blue)
- [ ] **JOB icon-on-background = #FFFFFF**
- [ ] Reddit Sans font family — no system fallback
- [ ] Display weight = bold 700 (NOT semi-bold 600)
- [ ] Header weight = semi-bold 600 (NOT bold 700)
- [ ] Body weight = regular 400
- [ ] Label weight = bold 700
- [ ] Button CTA icon → use `icon-on-background` (NOT `icon-primary`)
- [ ] Token format in spec: `token-name (#hex)` — token name is contract, hex is reference
- [ ] Spacing in YAML: always `spacing-N` (raw px chỉ dùng cho height/width tuyệt đối)
- [ ] JOB background-brand-light-secondary = #e4ecfb (dùng cho lock icon container)
- [ ] radius-modal = 20 (drawer surface)
